name: falcon-yara-bi-e5-base-v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from intfloat/e5-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. A full contrastive finetune of intfloat/e5-base-v2 (109M, BERT-base, hidden 768, 12 layers, 512 max positions, 768 output dims), trained to map cyber-threat-intelligence text and YARA rules into one embedding space with symmetric InfoNCE over in-batch negatives. Same config.json and tensor set as the base. Licence cc-by-nc-nd-4.0 — non-commercial, no derivatives — repo created 2026-05-28. Both benchmark rows are the repo's own YARA retrieval test split: the card's 'pretrained' row is the untrained e5-base-v2 backbone measured on the same split with the same harness, so this is a genuine same-table base comparison, but it is a private domain benchmark and not BEIR or MTEB. The gain is large because the base has no notion of YARA syntax at all. The card ships five training runs and they are all within 0.002 recall@1 of each other (run_3 has the best F1 at 0.9381); the released checkpoint is run_0 and only run_0's numbers are recorded.
